units.source_text: 然而，后来联系起来考虑，这只不过是我自作聪明罢了。

en.t: However, thinking about it later in connection with what followed, this was nothing more than my own clever misinterpretation.

units.source_text: 也许名人只是感到胸部憋气。

en.t: Perhaps the Master had simply felt tightness in his chest.

units.source_text: 接连多日对弈，名人的心脏病恶化了。

en.t: After playing games for many days in succession, the Master's heart disease worsened.

units.source_text: 那大概是初次轻微发作。

en.t: That was probably his first mild attack.

units.source_text: 我不知道名人有心脏病，所以得到那样的印象，

en.t: I did not know that the Master had heart disease, and so I came away with that impression,

units.source_text: 这虽是一种尊敬的表现，但也是荒诞的。

en.t: and although it was a form of respect, it was also absurd.

units.source_text: 那时节，名人许是没觉察自己有病，也没发现自己呼吸异常吧，

en.t: At that time, the Master may not have realized that he was ill, nor noticed that his breathing was abnormal,

units.source_text: 他脸上丝毫没有露出痛苦和不安的神色，也不曾用手去抚摸胸口。

en.t: for his face showed not the slightest sign of pain or unease, and he never raised a hand to touch his chest.
